phase_1_delete_product.summary: deleteProduct(productId) + purgePoisonedProducts() + undoDeleteProduct() in scanStore. Delete archives the product (status:archived + verified:false so the deterministic resolver/matcher stop matching it), deactivates ALL its aliases (approved:false), removes its InventoryCount rows, detaches its scan-feed rows, and drops catalog/shop-override entries keyed to its codes. Idempotent + audited (product_deleted/product_purged). Full pre-delete snapshot kept for an exact Undo. UI: platformOwner-gated Delete on every row in the Products page AND FinalCountTable (testid delete-product-<id>), plain-language confirm, downloaded JSON backup, UndoDeleteBanner. Archived products hidden from the Products list but kept for Undo+audit. Customer privacy gate unchanged.
phase_1_delete_product.tests: deleteProduct.store.test.ts (6): archive+deactivate+remove count; freed code re-scans to Needs Review not the deleted product; Undo restores exactly + code resolves again; deleting one dup leaves others; idempotent no-op; purge removes poison + leaves seed/manual, reversible. e2e delete-product.spec: delete from UI + Undo restores (screenshots).

Removes the ~235 duplicate Manstel rows saved on the non-matching code 745125495781. Targeted in-session purgePoisonedProducts() action (reversible) added in phase 1.
